animation_rule: The feasible-best entry's representative pair of the absolute S and absolute R/K65 arms (their RC runs) and the replay run they share, exported on the task clock so matching frames show matching task times.
c11_caveat: C11: the feasible-middle absolute R/K65 fit did not demonstrate numerical agreement with S-effective within the approved tolerance (largest prediction difference 2.93e-8 rad); the fit is retained unchanged, the exact-arithmetic ridge identity stands, and this small discrepancy does not establish that closed-loop behavior is unaffected.
representative_rule: For every panel entry, the first pair of the fixed evaluation order (the nominal scenario under pd_v2) of the absolute S, R/K65, R-scaled/K65, and A-contractive/K65 arms and of the residual S arm, whatever its outcome. Declared at the start of M3REP-007, after the execution accounting was visible; the rule selects by position in the panel, never by result, so failures are shown as often as successes.
